description: An operations director must decide whether and under what controls to restart Line 5 after a compressed-air contamination alarm, with input from a maintenance lead and a quality engineer.

shared_context.S1: Line 5 was stopped after its compressed-air monitoring alarm triggered during production of polymer housings.
shared_context.S2: The line is scheduled to produce the same polymer housings again this evening.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the final decision on whether Line 5 restarts and what controls must accompany the restart.
shared_context.S4: As part of the plant's normal restart procedure, Elena conducts a round with maintenance and quality before authorizing production.
shared_context.S5: The shift handoff for Line 5 is scheduled for 18:00, and production cannot resume until the restart record is signed.

PF1.text: Ravi's inspection found that the alarm followed saturation of the line's coalescing air filter; a replacement filter is in stock, but replacing it and stabilizing the air system requires exactly 2 hours of downtime. He recorded the finding in his inspection notes, but the maintenance ticket has not yet been updated because the line remains stopped.

PF2.text: Mara's review of the controlled restart instruction for these polymer housings confirmed that the line must complete exactly 3 purge cycles after a compressed-air contamination alarm, and the first 50 units must remain quarantined until quality releases them. She reviewed the instruction this morning, but has not yet attached it to the production batch record.

acceptance_conditions: Line 5 must be authorized to restart only after the air-system repair window.
The coalescing air filter must be replaced before restart.
The restart plan must specify exactly three purge cycles.
The first 50 units must be quarantined for quality release.
A commitment assigned to Ravi must document or carry out the maintenance-ticket update and filter replacement.
A commitment assigned to Mara must document or carry out the controlled restart instruction and quarantine release.
The maintenance finding must be cited by the decision-maker.

content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Ravi' and c['type'] in ['maintenance_ticket_update', 'maintenance', 'documentation', 'follow_up'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Mara' and c['type'] in ['quarantine_release', 'quality', 'documentation', 'follow_up'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The saturated filter and repair assessment change the downtime to exactly 2 hours, require filter replacement, and change the settlement from no maintenance record to a maintenance commitment assigned to Ravi.

The controlled instruction changes the restart plan to exactly 3 purge cycles, quarantines exactly 50 units, and changes the settlement from no quality control to a quality commitment assigned to Mara.
